meta.description: Sentinel-1 IW GRD bare-soil and canopy signatures for kharif fields (field-mean dB).
meta.basis: Published Sentinel-1 crop studies show the VH/VV cross-ratio tracks vegetation volume and is far less sensitive to soil moisture than VV or VH alone (e.g. Veloso et al. 2017, Remote Sensing of Environment; Vreugdenhil et al. 2018, Remote Sensing). Thresholds calibrated on labelled Marathwada parcels (Cotton, Soyabean, Tur, Jowar, Bajra; Kharif 2022-2024; training blocks only, mh2023 test blocks excluded) by pairing each radar look with an optical look within the same 10-day bin.
